title: Eventual Consistency

searches.query: "Eventual Consistency" system design interview conflicts read your writes
searches.result: success; exact-concept search executed, but independent frequency/rank/company evidence was insufficient; prompts are original production adaptations and technical decisions use checked primary sources

sources.title: Werner Vogels: Eventually Consistent — Revisited
sources.supportRationale: Eventual convergence and reader/session variants as distinct promises; historical product examples are not current product guarantees.

sources.title: DeCandia et al.: Dynamo (SOSP 2007)
sources.supportRationale: Historical Dynamo placement, versioning and repair mechanisms; not a claim about current DynamoDB defaults.

sources.title: etcd v3.6: API guarantees
sources.supportRationale: Explicit v3.6 KV consistency, weaker serializable read option, watch limitations and lease behavior.

sources.title: Gilbert and Lynch: Brewer’s Conjecture (2002)
sources.supportRationale: Original asynchronous-model impossibility result and precise atomic consistency/availability definitions; an inaccessible MIT URL was replaced by the author's copy.

scenarios.theme: A writer cannot see their own successful profile change. What do you do?
scenarios.assumptions: Other users may see delayed updates, but the editor must not be shown an older saved state. What will you do and why?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Eventual Consistency to own save.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: A writer cannot see their own successful profile change. What do you do?

production-prompt.rationale: Prompt states a production failure or workload bound and asks for a justified response.

direct-answer.rationale: Reviewed action: Carry the acknowledged version and read from a source able to meet that session requirement, or wait/present pending within a deadline

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: Version tracking adds state and can reduce availability when no eligible source is reachable

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: A local optimistic preview improves UX but cannot certify that the saved record is durable.

evidence.rationale: Primary support mapped to eventual, etcd; interview frequency is not claimed.

full-delivery.rationale: Three labeled parts are self-contained; native disclosure and host confidence integration use stable keys.
